verbatim_excerpt: Participating Part D plan sponsors must ensure that no covered patient in a participating Enhanced Alternative (EA) plan or Employer Group Waiver Plan (EGWP), while in the initial coverage phase of the Part D benefit, pays more than $50 per 28- or 30-day supply in total out-of-pocket costs (including co-pay, co-insurance, or other direct costs) to receive any model drug listed in Appendix C from an in-network pharmacy. -- NOTE: reproduced from domain-restricted search output, not a direct read of the PDF.
